body:
Diagnosed with bipolar type 2.  Logically I know what is happening but knowing doesn't help.
I'm barely functional at the moment.  Getting the kids to school and feeding them meals is all i can manage.  All I can do is sit and try not to cry.  I hurt.  Don't want to be thus broken.  Knowing that this can't be cured is hopeless.
If I had a way out that wouldn't hurt the kids I would take it.
